body.x: E3 Co. Ltd. introduced ‘Aircok’ a portable fine dust measuring instrument by participating at ‘2017 Korea Electronics Show(KES)’ which is hosted at Samsung-dong Coex for 4 days from 17th of October(Tues) to 20th(Fri)

E3 which launched a fine dust measuring instrument called ‘Aircok Baby’ on this February, is a company that is receiving a lot attention from clients. Aircok Baby doesn’t only measure the density of fine dust, but also provide advises on a person's behavior according to environment and offer solutions. The good thing about this product is that you are provided with measurement and solutions via linked application.

Section chief of E3, Sang-yeol Heo said that ‘Aircok Familiy’ will be launched this November, it received a lot of attention at a crowd funding carried out recently. Moreover, he said that more and more people look for E3's products since environment is considered important in this era.

Meanwhile, KES 2017, hosted by Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Energy and sponsored by KEA (Korea Electronics Association), is an international show where lots of potential buyers, governments, group officials participate, providing a good place to experience world first products like mobile phone, semiconductor, display, and next generation convergence solutions like industrial convergence, IT convergence, digital broadcasting, smart education and e health.
